knowledge_cards.claim: Stage-1 improvement is one-benchmark objective evidence; challenge rho does not independently validate the metrics.
Report restoration by source class and degradation; validation/macro averages can hide transfer failures.
Dry references exist in MSRBench, but outputs remain estimates through non-invertible stem/bus/master/degradation chains.
Five-system rank rho=0.9 across different test sets is not clip/stem/project metric validation.
Transient percussion needs separate attack/phase protection and cannot inherit bass/tonal-source acceptance criteria.
Related open code is not experimental parity code unless architecture, version, weights, config and preprocessing match.
